svg.text: Visible flame extinction diameter vs O2 (N2-only, extinction runs)
Eligible: test end = Extinction, positive diameter, no extrapolation noted in the caption. D0 also varies. Colour = pressure cluster.
All support modes pooled (support mode not controlled; its only source is the unregistered NASA/TP-2015-216046).
